content:
Global Market Leadership Rankings

Data shared by Statcounter for November 2025 clarified user preferences in the artificial intelligence market. On a global scale, ChatGPT continues to maintain its lead by a wide margin with an 81.84% market share. Despite competitors’ aggressive marketing strategies and integrations, no fundamental shift in user habits has been observed.

The global market share rankings are as follows:

  • ChatGPT: 81.84%
  • Perplexity: 11.06%
  • Copilot: 3.06%
  • Gemini: 2.97%
  • Claude: 1.06%
  • Deepseek: 0.01%

Turkey AI Usage Statistics

Data from the Turkish market points to ChatGPT dominance that exceeds the global average. More than 90% of users in Turkey prefer OpenAI solutions as their primary AI tool. This percentage indicates that alternatives have not yet found sufficient traction in the local market.

Market share distribution in Turkey:

  • ChatGPT: 90.24%
  • Gemini: 5.62%
  • Perplexity: 2.02%
  • Copilot: 1.57%
  • Claude: 0.55%

Competition and Technical Preferences

Led by ChatGPT, its constantly updated model architecture and the integration of browser-like features such as ChatGPT Atlas are proving effective. Although Google has taken steps such as offering free AI Pro memberships for Gemini and integrating it into its ecosystem, users generally view Gemini as a secondary tool.

On the other hand, although its overall market share appears low, Claude holds a significant position, particularly among software developers. It continues to be preferred by technical teams for code reading, debugging, and working with large context windows. However, this technical niche has a limited impact on overall market share figures.
